job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced GenAI Engineer to join our team at Altimetrik Corp. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI engineering and be able to work on complex projects.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and deploy AI models and algorithms to solve complex problems.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and develop solutions.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Work on natural language processing and computer vision tasks.


Participate in code reviews and improve the overall quality of the codebase.


Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in AI technology.




Job Requirements




Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java.


Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.


Familiarity with agile development methodologies and version control systems.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.




Additional Info



The company has identified an internal candidate for this role.
